notes: Lottery Coins can be obtained as rewards from Wave Duels, both as First Completion Rewards as above, and as rewards from duel results.
Rewards above are for duel victories. A loss results in half the reward.

The player can spend a multiple of 30 Lottery Coins (max. 3000 at a time) to obtain one random reward for each 30 Lottery Coins spent. The Lottery remained available until a week after the event's conclusion and could be accessed from the "Information" menu.
